roadMarkingsEvidence: București way48216570 is mapped with6lanes(3forward/3backward); SV01 shows two dashed separators on the south half and SV02 the three-arrow approach sign. preservedNativeBusStops.name: Piața Ovidiu
preservedNativeBusStops.evidence: Current OSM shelter=yes plus historical April2019 Street View supports function. Current shelter form not verified; retain native instance, no custom replacement or instance mask. Node is a functional map position on road side of kerb, not a shelter footprint.

raisedIslands.evidence: SV09 confirms a raised small separator with kerb. Plan extent, .16m border and .14m offset are estimates; road coverage and pedestrian routes are unchanged.

accessTerrainEvidence.source: Existing DEM sampled by runtime QA,2026-10-23; not surveyed threshold elevations

milesti12_2.action: Keep the existing natural DEM decline; no artificial relative offset or uniform platform. The access remains continuous and kerb-free.

surfaceEnvelopeBodies.evidence: Official single envelope remains unchanged. Orthophotos2020/2026 depict an open landscaped court, not one tall block. Only the small mapped/visible technical structure w1331464220 is extruded. Court is rendered at conservative terrain grade; whether it is over a podium and its true elevation are not confirmed by street photographs.
surfaceEnvelopeBodies.groundOwnership: The listed cells are owned by a permanent court landscape group, removed from the evictable group. Body and affected native requests await the complete court ground; no duplicated floor mesh.

withheldNativeAssociations.reason: Relation also covers43.7m2 of unselected retained coarse body1832777, chunk15/6. No explicit BUC06 native-ID request; ready-footprint masking and the retained coarse owner govern its display.

nativeReplacementDependencies.evidence: No explicit native request is emitted for this relation. The three negative footprint owners that could collectively hide81.23% of its shell await retained coarse chunk15/6, so its43.7m2 contact with body1832777 is not erased before that representation is ready.

preservedNativeEvidence: Previous BUC05 and AugustCiuflea/Vasilenco ownership remains exact. Native bus-stop PiațaOvidiu is retained; source node locates function, not the surveyed shelter footprint. Midtown positive native proxy remains with AugustCiuflea and is never duplicated in BUC06.

supersededPreviousBodies.evidence: Complete official envelope replaces the prior OSM-derived Midtown model only after the complete body and associated corrected ground are ready. Prior source file remains byte-identical; AugustCiuflea retains the single native positive-ID proxy.

previousOwnerHandoffs.evidence: Prior source files remain unchanged. The whole old body and these old ground jobs stay visible until the replacement body and all required corrected ground cells are ready; the new owners then remain resident. Original ground materials and role offsets are retained outside the new official envelope. The existing positive native-ID proxy stays with the previous layer.

evidence: Official p/holes are complete source geometry. Parcels/address points are provenance only; no height is supplied by the official layer.
All elevation dimensions, facade details, minor furniture positions, tree dimensions and paint widths are estimated from identified images/current mapped outlines.
Ground reconstruction preserves previous byte-identical sectors except an explicit dynamic Midtown body/7-cell handoff. Original representations remain visible until complete replacements are ready.
The large official37608 envelope includes landscaped open court; the elevation and whether it lies on a podium are unconfirmed. Rendering at conservative terrain grade is an explicit assumption.
No vehicles from photographs are reconstructed. Existing interactive game vehicles and traffic behaviors remain owned by existing systems.
